text.en: Believing the Laplace transform of a derivative, L{f'(t)}, equals s·F(s) with nothing else — forgetting the initial-condition term, so L{f'(t)} = s·F(s) − f(0) collapses to just s·F(s) and the whole point of turning an initial value problem into an algebraic one is lost.
text.et: Arvamine, et tuletise Laplace'i teisendus L{f'(t)} on lihtsalt s·F(s) — unustades algtingimuse liikme, mistõttu õige valem L{f'(t)} = s·F(s) − f(0) taandub eksikombel s·F(s)-ks ja kaob just see, mis muudab algväärtusülesande algebraliseks ülesandeks.
